def solve(case):
    payload = case["payload"]
    nodes = payload["nodes"]
    required = payload["required_symbols"]
    node_dict = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n["parent"]
        if pid is not None:
            children[pid].append(n["id"])
    all_ids = set(node_dict.keys())
    retained = set(all_ids)
    removal_order = []
    # sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        if node["symbol"] in required:
            continue
        # compute subtree ids rooted at this node within retained set
        subtree = set()
        stack = [nid]
        while stack:
            cur = stack.pop()
            if cur not in retained:
                continue
            if cur in subtree:
                continue
            subtree.add(cur)
            for child in children.get(cur, []):
                if child in retained:
                    stack.append(child)
        # check that no required symbol node is in subtree
        has_required = False
        for sid in subtree:
            if node_dict[sid]["symbol"] in required:
                has_required = True
                break
        if has_required:
            continue
        # check that after removal, all required symbols still represented (by nodes not in subtree)
        remaining = retained - subtree
        remaining_symbols = {node_dict[nid]["symbol"] for nid in remaining}
        if all(sym in remaining_symbols for sym in required):
            retained = remaining
            removal_order.append(nid)
    sorted_retained = sorted(list(retained))
    return {"retained": sorted_retained, "removal_order": removal_order}
